title: suderra.edge-provisioning.v2 device-bound provisioning manifest
description: Signed by the edge-provisioning key (ADR-048 DEC-3.1, DEC-5.5, DEC-5.6, DEC-22). It binds one device (device_binding, device_id, tenant_id, nonce) to one release statement, one config payload and one trust-anchor bundle by digest; root verifies each of those against its own key. v2 because suderra.edge-provisioning.v1 names the earlier non-DSSE, re-serialized format of Suderra-OS userspace/suderra-installer/src/contracts.rs, which this format replaces; one name never denotes two shapes.

nonce.description: Echo of the nonce the device sent with GET /install/:code/suderra-os (DEC-5.5).

key_epoch.description: Must equal the epoch of the key the DSSE keyid resolved to; it never selects a key (DEC-3.4).

release_statement.description: Where root fetches the suderra.edge-release.v1 envelope and the statement digest it must have.

artifact_url.description: Download location of the release artifact; its integrity comes from the release statement, not from this URL.

config_payload.description: Digest and size of the config payload delivered with the manifest. Its format is the suderra.site-config.v1 statement (DEC-4.12), which contract 1.0.0 does not define; root binds the bytes by digest and size.

trust_anchors.description: Statement digest and bundle_seq of the suderra.trust-anchors.v1 bundle delivered with the manifest (DEC-3.7).
